SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_resources, COUNT(DISTINCT host) AS n_hosts, COUNT(DISTINCT pay_to) AS n_pay_to, SUM(calls_30d) AS calls_30d_sum FROM x402_b4b1827b.catalog_resources

SELECT host, calls_30d_sum, n_resources, catalog_calls_30d_sum FROM (SELECT host, SUM(calls_30d) AS calls_30d_sum, COUNT(*) AS n_resources, SUM(SUM(calls_30d)) OVER () AS catalog_calls_30d_sum FROM x402_b4b1827b.catalog_resources GROUP BY host) t ORDER BY calls_30d_sum DESC, host LIMIT 10
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN calls_30d > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_active, COUNT(*) AS n_resources FROM x402_b4b1827b.catalog_resources

SELECT pay_to, calls_30d_sum, catalog_calls_30d_sum FROM (SELECT pay_to, SUM(calls_30d) AS calls_30d_sum, SUM(SUM(calls_30d)) OVER () AS catalog_calls_30d_sum FROM x402_b4b1827b.catalog_resources GROUP BY pay_to) t ORDER BY calls_30d_sum DESC, pay_to LIMIT 10
SELECT endpoints_listed, endpoints_active, settlements_30d, settled_volume_usd_30d, distinct_payers_30d, distinct_receivers_30d FROM x402_b4b1827b.trust_stats
SELECT MAX(payers_30d) AS max_payers_30d FROM x402_b4b1827b.catalog_resources
